disambiguation: It is a Bible reference rendering tool, not a general journaling application.
extras: Requires an account at api.esv.org to obtain an ESV API token for download-on-demand functionality.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances your Bible study and journaling in Obsidian by rendering Bible verse references and passages directly in your notes.
problem: Standard note-taking methods lack a way to easily embed, render, and interact with specific Bible verses and passages within a note.
summary: Renders Bible verse references and passages directly within Obsidian notes, allowing for interactive viewing, local storage, and structured study.
